notes.title: Ver1.0.3 Update
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where destroying a boss just as the time was up could sometimes result in the full boss time bonus being obtained, although the timing was strict.

notes.title: Ver1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Added tutorial explanation
Fixed radar display
Enemy bullet collision changes
Item collision changes
Rolling fix

notes.title: Full version released
notes.notes:
The full version of Missile Dancer 2 has been released.
Please enjoy the new Super Scale Game.

notes.title: About full version release
notes.notes: The full version of Missile Dancer 2 will be released on March 28, 2023. It supports online leaderboards in all modes, and the arcade mode has a total of 16 stages. The content is the same as the Nintendo Switch version. Please look forward to the full version.

notes.title: DEMO version has been released.
notes.notes:
The DEMO version of the latest work "Missile Dancer 2" has been released.
In the DEMO version, you can play Caravan mode (3 minute score attack).
If you like it, please add it to your wishlist and wait for the release of the product version.
Thank you for your continuous support.
